name: Nimule
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: A 2024 environmental and social impact report hosted by the Government of South Sudan states that Nimule land is primarily administered by a local Land Board and Town Council, while the formal multi-level land-administration reforms are incomplete. This confirms local land governance but not a statutory registry, parcel database, or public cadastral service.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Nimule has a formal statutory land registry or survey archive in addition to the reported community Land Board; exact settlement extent and whether it intersects a documented parcel dataset.
